findings.title: Le Croissant-Rouge : 46 patients et accompagnateurs évacués pour recevoir des soins à l’étranger via le point de passage de Rafah
findings.publisher: WAFA French (Palestine News and Information Agency), citing Palestinian Red Crescent Society
findings.location: Al-Mawasi field hospital, Gaza Strip; Rafah crossing; outbound medical transfers
findings.affected_population_system: 23 patients requiring treatment abroad and 23 accompanying persons; medical evacuation and transport logistics
findings.summary: French WAFA reports Palestinian Red Crescent teams assisted evacuation of 23 patients and 23 accompanying people via Rafah with WHO coordination, preparing patients and providing medical and humanitarian support at its Al-Mawasi field hospital. Total 46 PERSONS, not 46 patients. Published 14:35 Gaza-local, before observation start but newly corroborated after prior watch rejected an untraceable automated 46-patients claim.
findings.exact_supporting_passage: 23 patients et de 23 accompagnateurs vers l’étranger, via le point de passage de Rafah
findings.source_verification: Search-indexed full WAFA French article body and dated metadata available. Direct article open returned DisabledError; PRCS website accessible but its front-page news did not yet corroborate this operation; WHO EMRO unavailable.

bounded_discovery_context.prior_heartbeat_comparison: Prior 05:46:45 PST ledger explicitly excluded automated GazaNews.live claim of '46 patients' evacuated for lack of traceable primary/established reporting. Newly located French WAFA provides attributable statement and corrects count to 23 patients plus 23 companions.
bounded_discovery_context.novelty_scope: Newly corroborated medical evacuation report, not verified as a new operation during the last hour.
bounded_discovery_context.duplicate_handling: One evacuation of 23 patients and 23 companions; do not count all 46 as patients or add to unrelated evacuation reports.
